title: 👻 The $249 Ghost Sale
why_read: A casual personal blog post about asking an AI chatbot for marketing advice for a small art shop lacks substantial technical depth.
analysis: This post describes the author's experience asking an AI assistant to analyze their small online shop's sales data and suggest marketing improvements for their art business. It reads as a personal, informal narrative rather than a structured technical exploration of analytics or AI tooling. There is little transferable technical insight for a general engineering audience beyond an anecdote about casual AI assistant use.
